name: Tear Resilience [Psionic] [Combat]
body:
You have learned to fight around bolstering abilities that would normally staunch your strikes.

Prerequisite(s): Psionic Weapon or Psionic Fist

Benefit(s): Your melee attacks ignore any temporary hit points the target may have. The target retains these temporary hit points, but damage from your attack subtracts from the creature’s regular supply of hit points without acknowledging the temporary hit points.
